facts.fact: Starlink, operated by SpaceX, sells satellite internet in Nigeria and had 65,564 subscribers at the end of 2024, up from 23,897 in 2023, making it the second-largest ISP, citing NCC data.
Subscribers: 65,564 at 2024-12, per NCC (Starlink, as reported by TechCabal; up from 23,897 in 2023).
